question.:question/worked-solution:

$$
\begin{vmatrix}a & b \\ c & d\end{vmatrix}=ad-bc.
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}det(R) & =\begin{vmatrix}3 & 0 \\ 6 & 2\end{vmatrix} \\  & =(3)(2)-(0)(6) \\  & =6-0 \\  & =6.\end{aligned}
$$
